templates.why_chosen: Star, high-confidence layered exemplar with tier names in a right-hand gutter (Application, Kernel-space, I/O devices) across 4 dashed-divided bands, and white-vs-gray boxes distinguishing ZRAID's functional logic from its in-memory state, in 13 components.
templates.what_to_learn: Put tier labels in a slim right gutter instead of inside the band, use two flat fills, white for logic and gray for state, to separate function from data within one tier, and draw the repeated bottom-tier devices once in full detail then abbreviate the rest to a label only.
